answer: Write the formula on its own line before you substitute. Examiners give a mark for stating $W = Fs\cos\theta$, and a missing $\cos\theta$ costs the substitution and calculation marks that follow. With $F = 10$ N, $s = 5$ m and $\theta = 60^\circ$: $W = 10 \times 5 \times 0.5 = 25$ J.

citations.snippet: Work done by a force at an angle: W = F s cos(theta).
